verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a public API suite for programmatically managing connections, transformations and other features. It covers Transformations and Libraries, audit logs, organization usage metrics, Event Audit metadata, and event ingestion via the HTTP and Pixel APIs. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the standard paths returned 404), detailed per-endpoint coverage of connection/source/destination management beyond the summary line, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Explore the RudderStack APIs to programmatically manage your RudderStack connections, transformations and other RudderStack features.
Manage your RudderStack Transformations and Libraries
Get organization-level event usage metrics by workspace, source, and time bucket
Send event data from source to connected destinations
